preferences: spiced stew after a hard road
motives: They want a company that remembers every name it sends below.
Old debts brought them to the Hearth, but pride may keep them here.
They are hunting the truth behind a family story.
They want honest work, reliable companions, and a road worth surviving.
They have something to prove to a home that stopped believing in them.
hooks: They learned early that preparation is another name for courage.
They speak little about the expedition that cost their last company everything.
Their gear is carefully maintained, though none of it quite matches.
They keep a small token from every place they safely leave behind.
Mercenary habits hide a surprising tenderness for frightened newcomers.

traits.name: Keen
traits.description: +1 accuracy; healing received is reduced by 1.

traits.name: Hardy
traits.description: Healing received +1; movement actions cannot gain bonus distance.

traits.name: Restless
traits.description: Acts quickly, but is slow to recover morale.

traits.name: Scholarly
traits.description: Excels at lore tests; physical trials are less reliable.

curated.name: Brina
curated.personality: Patient, dry-witted, and stubbornly protective.
curated.motivation: I want to prove that steady hands can outlast the Briarway.
curated.biography: Brina held a palisade gate while her neighbors escaped a forest surge. An old friend of Alden, she came to the Hearth because his first expedition proved that courage deserves witnesses—and better preparation.

curated.name: Eamon
curated.personality: Curious, formal, and incapable of leaving a mystery alone.
curated.motivation: A prison is not repaired by striking whatever moves inside it.
curated.biography: Eamon copied forbidden marginalia until his tutors barred him from the covenant archive. He believes the Briarway is an approach grown around a failing seal, and that Nordia's call to destroy every prisoner mistakes certainty for knowledge.

curated.name: Garrick
curated.personality: Gruff, dependable, and embarrassed by praise.
curated.motivation: One good company is worth ten loud captains.
curated.biography: Garrick survived three collapsed companies by knowing when bravado had outrun sense. He seeks a final honest career under a roof that records its dead.

curated.name: Veya
curated.personality: Warm, competitive, and impossible to discourage.
curated.preference: spiced stew after a hard road
curated.motivation: I intend to return with a story worth exaggerating.
curated.biography: Veya learned swordwork defending barges from marsh raiders. Her cheerful boasting masks meticulous preparation and an old fear of deep water.

curated.name: Soren
curated.personality: Reserved, exacting, and fiercely fair.
curated.motivation: A clean contract and a dangerous road are enough.
curated.biography: Soren left a celebrated mercenary band when its victories became excuses for cruelty. They now judge employers by how they treat the least famous recruit.

curated.name: Nessa
curated.personality: Incisive, skeptical, and secretly sentimental.
curated.motivation: Every ruin is an argument with the people who named it empty.
curated.biography: Nessa mapped sealed hill tunnels for miners before the walls began answering her questions. She studies dangerous places because ignorance has already cost her one home.

curated.name: Quill
curated.personality: Talkative, inventive, and gloriously disorganized.
curated.motivation: Theoretical magic improves remarkably when chased by wolves.
curated.biography: Quill sold harmless charms from a canal boat until one accidentally opened a drowned shrine. They have been pursuing practical education ever since.

curated.name: Ilyra
curated.personality: Severe, thoughtful, and unexpectedly funny.
curated.motivation: I have spent enough years reading warnings written by cowards.
curated.biography: Ilyra once taught wardcraft to noble heirs and watched them ignore every lesson. She wants her remaining work to protect people who understand consequences.

curated.name: Rhea
curated.personality: Gentle in speech and immovable in crisis.
curated.preference: spiced stew after a hard road
curated.motivation: Someone should make sure bravery gets home alive.
curated.biography: Rhea kept a fever ward running through a winter siege. She carries the names of those she lost and refuses to treat survival as selfishness.

curated.name: Hale
curated.personality: Boisterous, attentive, and hard to fool.
curated.motivation: I have buried enough heroes who thought asking for help was weakness.
curated.biography: Hale served as a battlefield orderly for commanders who counted banners instead of lives. He now chooses smaller companies where every decision has a face.

curated.name: Petra
curated.personality: Watchful, compassionate, and blunt about danger.
curated.motivation: The Forest wounds more than flesh. I know how to listen.
curated.biography: Petra followed blighted animal trails until they learned to recognize the Forest's moods. They heal travelers partly to learn what the wild changed in them.

curated.name: Fara
curated.personality: Practical, irreverent, and quietly devout.
curated.motivation: Miracles work better when someone remembers the bandages.
curated.biography: Fara grew up among pilgrim barges and learned six traditions of healing. She distrusts grand prophecies but never refuses ordinary mercy.

curated.name: Ulric
curated.personality: Formal, patient, and immovably loyal.
curated.motivation: A shield is a promise made before the danger arrives.
curated.biography: Ulric guarded a mountain gate that no army ever attacked. He came south when he realized readiness is wasted where nothing remains to protect.

curated.name: Dessa
curated.personality: Quiet, observant, and unexpectedly mischievous.
curated.motivation: I know what happens when a line has nobody left to hold it.
curated.biography: Dessa rebuilt her village's walls twice before accepting that stone alone could not save it. She protects people now, not places.

curated.name: Merek
curated.personality: Disciplined, sardonic, and protective of rookies.
curated.motivation: Point me toward the thing everyone else needs time to survive.
curated.biography: Merek was paid to guard nobles who fled before their soldiers. They now reserve loyalty for companions who stand beside them.

curated.name: Orin
curated.personality: Contemplative, stubborn, and fond of terrible riddles.
curated.motivation: Patience defeats monsters long before steel does.
curated.biography: Orin studied defensive forms copied from ancient tomb reliefs. He wants to test whether forgotten warriors understood threats the present age has yet to meet.

curated.name: Tamsin
curated.personality: Charming, evasive, and loyal once trusted.
curated.preference: spiced stew after a hard road
curated.motivation: Locked doors usually protect the most interesting mistakes.
curated.biography: Tamsin guided smugglers through flooded ruins until they abandoned a trapped passenger. She kept the passenger and abandoned the smugglers.

curated.name: Corin
curated.personality: Cautious, soft-spoken, and relentlessly curious.
curated.motivation: I prefer learning where danger sleeps before someone wakes it.
curated.biography: Corin tracked poachers until their trails crossed things that left no footprints. He now studies the spaces where ordinary evidence stops.

curated.name: Wren
curated.personality: Wry, adaptable, and allergic to ceremony.
curated.motivation: I am looking for better odds and better people, in that order.
curated.biography: Wren made a career retrieving valuables that owners had unwisely misplaced behind guards. A betrayal convinced them that honest danger may be safer.

curated.name: Lysa
curated.personality: Unflappable, private, and ruthlessly prepared.
curated.motivation: Survival is a craft. I have practiced longer than most.
curated.biography: Lysa escorted caravans through three wars without losing a client. She refuses to explain why she left that work, but still counts every exit on entering a room.

curated.name: Joren
curated.personality: Earnest, intuitive, and more comfortable with beasts.
curated.motivation: The wild is frightened. I want to know what frightened it.
curated.biography: Joren survived his village's destruction because a wolf led him through smoke. He has spent years learning why some bonds form without words.

curated.name: Rhea
curated.personality: Playful, perceptive, and fiercely independent.
curated.motivation: Every sealed place has an ecosystem. Usually an angry one.
curated.biography: Rhea catalogued cave life for an academy that discarded every inconvenient discovery. They travel now with a companion who never asks them to simplify the truth.

curated.name: Kael
curated.personality: Serene, eccentric, and difficult to surprise.
curated.motivation: A bond tested only in peace is merely an acquaintance.
curated.biography: Kael raised messenger beasts in an isolated monastery. When one returned carrying a map from a vanished expedition, he followed its trail south.

curated.name: Petra
curated.personality: Brisk, generous, and delightfully competitive.
curated.preference: spiced stew after a hard road
curated.motivation: My companion thinks this place smells promising. I trust her judgment.
curated.biography: Petra guarded livestock barges until she discovered she could hear the alarm before the animals made a sound. She treats her bonded companion as an equal partner.

curated.name: Anwen
curated.personality: Plainspoken, vigilant, and fond of small practical jokes.
curated.preference: a dry cloak and a seat facing the door
curated.motivation: A crossing is only safe when the last traveler reaches the far bank.
curated.biography: Anwen defended a rope ferry when the winter road became impassable. She refused a captain's order to abandon the stranded passengers and now seeks a company whose promises extend beyond its payroll.

curated.name: Bastien
curated.personality: Gentle in conversation and unwavering in a crisis.
curated.motivation: I want the roads cleared without turning every living thing into an enemy.
curated.biography: Bastien used pruning hooks before he ever carried a sword. After a prison surge poisoned his family's orchards, he escorted the survivors to higher ground. He measures victory by how much can still grow afterward.

curated.name: Kiva
curated.origin: the lantern harbors of the Veiled Isles
curated.personality: Observant, theatrical, and surprisingly careful with beginners.
curated.preference: songs that remember the people who lost
curated.motivation: Tell me what we are fighting before you ask me to draw.
curated.biography: Kiva earned coin settling shipboard quarrels with a practice blade. A duel over a stolen funerary token taught them that a celebrated winner can still be wrong. They came inland to question the stories told about the prisoners.

curated.name: Ronan
curated.personality: Patient, self-effacing, and fiercely loyal once convinced.
curated.preference: a written route and a shared breakfast
curated.motivation: I have guarded enough cargo. I would like to guard people who know my name.
curated.biography: Ronan spent a decade walking beside grain wagons whose owners never learned his name. He brought an injured apprentice through the Briarway instead of protecting an insured shipment. The Hearth offers him a different kind of contract.

curated.name: Asha
curated.personality: Precise, curious, and delighted by a convincing correction.
curated.preference: clear skies and notebooks with wide margins
curated.motivation: If the seals move together, their failures must have a pattern.
curated.biography: Asha repaired the lenses used to chart divine conjunctions. She noticed every prison flare distorted the same stars, then lost her position for recording the discrepancy. She wants field evidence that cannot be polished out of a report.

curated.name: Darian
curated.personality: Methodical, courteous, and impatient with ceremonial answers.
curated.preference: inspection notes signed by everyone present
curated.motivation: A ward that looks respectable can still be broken. Let me test it.
curated.biography: Darian inspected public wards until a superior ordered him to certify a failing refuge. He copied the warning into every household ledger instead. His credentials are suspended, but his belief in public duty remains intact.

curated.name: Esme
curated.personality: Warm, skeptical, and attentive to the words people avoid.
curated.preference: shared dictionaries and sweet mint tea
curated.motivation: A promise translated carelessly is a promise changed.
curated.biography: Esme translated contracts between caravan families and local spirits. One missing condition cost a village its spring water. She now studies the original prison covenants and refuses to let convenience stand in for understanding.

curated.name: Tovin
curated.personality: Inventive, cheerful, and anxious about unfinished work.
curated.motivation: Give me a problem that matters more than keeping a rich tower bright.
curated.biography: Tovin kept roadside beacons burning with salvaged glass and improvised spellwork. When a governor diverted the fuel to his estate, they lit the evacuation road by hand. They seek companions willing to maintain what everyone else takes for granted.

curated.name: Maelin
curated.personality: Calm, direct, and difficult to hurry into a poor decision.
curated.preference: clean linen and a kettle kept warm
curated.motivation: Getting everyone home is work. I intend to be paid for doing it well.
curated.biography: Maelin delivered children and treated marsh fever along villages with no permanent clinic. She followed an outbreak upstream to a damaged seal. She joined the expedition roads because treating the same wound forever will not heal its source.

curated.name: Odel
curated.personality: Dry-witted, resourceful, and intolerant of needless sacrifice.
curated.preference: a full supply pouch and honest weather forecasts
curated.motivation: Bravery is useful. A prepared bandage is useful more often.
curated.biography: Odel searched avalanche fields with a borrowed shield for a stretcher. He grew tired of commanders calling preventable deaths honorable. His medical kit includes a ledger of mistakes he expects his next company to stop repeating.

curated.name: Suri
curated.personality: Soft-spoken, persistent, and protective of unpopular patients.
curated.preference: quiet company that asks before offering prayers
curated.motivation: A sentence should not decide whether a person deserves care.
curated.biography: Suri treated prisoners awaiting review in a courthouse hospice. After discovering that some names had been copied into the condemned register twice, they challenged the physician's oath used to justify neglect. They want the old prisoners examined with the same care.

curated.name: Yara
curated.personality: Brisk, compassionate, and happiest when everyone has a task.
curated.preference: salt broth and stories told without embellishment
curated.motivation: Put me where the wounded can reach me, and keep the route open.
curated.biography: Yara learned surgery aboard rescue boats where every instrument had to be tied down. She crossed inland after several crews returned with identical wounds from distant ports. She suspects something beneath the roads is reaching farther than the nations admit.

curated.name: Bram
curated.personality: Steady, exacting, and generous with hard-earned advice.
curated.preference: clear load limits and a sturdy chair
curated.motivation: A shield and a bridge do the same job: hold until everyone passes.
curated.biography: Bram shored failing bridges while merchants argued over who should pay. When a seal surge split a support pier, he held the evacuation line beneath it. He now wants to inspect the foundations the nations insist are beyond question.

curated.name: Cerys
curated.personality: Reserved, practical, and patient with frightened animals.
curated.preference: fresh air and room to set down heavy gear
curated.motivation: I can hold the line. Tell me what you plan to save behind it.
curated.biography: Cerys carried a tower shield along forest firebreaks, protecting crews from falling timber. She left a militia that burned healthy groves to contain a prison leak. Her idea of defense includes preserving a place worth returning to.

curated.name: Ivo
curated.personality: Formal, thoughtful, and unexpectedly playful off duty.
curated.motivation: Some boundaries protect a bargain. Some only protect the people who wrote it.
curated.biography: Ivo guarded wells maintained through agreements with buried spirits. They discovered that a steward had quietly changed the terms while charging travelers for the consequences. They seek the original prison records before deciding which walls deserve to stand.

curated.name: Nadia
curated.personality: Blunt, dependable, and quick to take responsibility.
curated.motivation: If a plan needs somebody to stay behind, make sure they have a way out.
curated.biography: Nadia kept a damaged floodgate closed while her neighbors evacuated, then escaped through an inspection culvert she had insisted on maintaining. She brings the same stubborn attention to exit routes into every expedition briefing.

curated.name: Elian
curated.personality: Polite, nimble, and interested in overlooked details.
curated.preference: a roof with a clear view of the road
curated.motivation: The quickest route is only useful if the whole party can follow.
curated.biography: Elian delivered storm warnings between lighthouses by climbing routes no cart could use. A message censored by a harbor magistrate cost a fishing fleet its chance to shelter. He came inland to carry warnings before somebody important can bury them.

curated.name: Fenra
curated.personality: Quiet, sharp-eyed, and unexpectedly generous with strangers.
curated.preference: warm bread and locks that work as intended
curated.motivation: I open doors for a living. I prefer to know why they were closed.
curated.biography: Fenra maintained the locks protecting village seed stores. She found a sealed storeroom full of healthy grain while refugees were being turned away. The key she took is still in her pouch, beside a list of other doors worth questioning.

curated.name: Lucan
curated.personality: Patient, skeptical, and happiest with a paper trail.
curated.preference: receipts kept in the right order
curated.motivation: Every sealed room has a history. Every official history leaves something out.
curated.biography: Lucan traced missing civic funds through a chain of impossible signatures. The inquiry ended when the final ledger disappeared into a temple vault. They want expedition records kept in ordinary hands, where authority cannot quietly revise the outcome.

curated.name: Zia
curated.personality: Quick-witted, sociable, and careful about whom she trusts.
curated.preference: spiced coffee and agreements spoken plainly
curated.motivation: Someone has to bring the appeal to the people who refuse to hear it.
curated.biography: Zia carried petitions between courts that kept moving their hearings farther from the villages affected. She learned to bypass a guard without humiliating one. Her next delivery concerns the right to challenge a sentence older than any living judge.

curated.name: Ari
curated.personality: Gentle, curious, and deeply uncomfortable with orders given without reasons.
curated.motivation: My companion agreed to come. I expect the same courtesy for everyone else.
curated.biography: Ari tended the creatures that pollinated old shrine gardens. They noticed their bonded moth refusing every flower watered downstream of a prison. They seek a company that treats the bond as a partnership rather than a convenient weapon.

curated.name: Hessa
curated.personality: Deliberate, hospitable, and precise about promises.
curated.preference: tea poured before a contract is discussed
curated.motivation: A willing ally is stronger than an obedient captive.
curated.biography: Hessa mediated disputes between families and the spirits living under their courtyards. She ended a profitable arrangement when she learned one party had never consented. She now asks the same question about the powers held beneath the dungeons.

curated.name: Pavel
curated.personality: Earnest, loyal, and more observant than his confidence suggests.
curated.preference: a place for his companion beside the table
curated.motivation: We know how to find people who cannot find their own way home.
curated.biography: Pavel and his bonded hound found travelers lost between winter courier stations. A rescue led them to a shrine humming beneath the snow, though every official map called it empty ground. They followed that sound toward the expedition roads.

curated.name: Vesper
curated.personality: Wry, patient, and stubborn about remembering proper names.
curated.preference: stories whose tellers name their sources
curated.motivation: Before we bind a spirit, I would like to hear its name from its own mouth.
curated.biography: Vesper recorded the voices remembered in her island's tide sanctuaries. One began using a name erased from the prison histories. She travels with a small bonded shell-spirit and insists that a dangerous witness is still a witness.
